data.heading: Questions about your money
data.subheading: We know trust matters. Here is how Ledgerly keeps your funds safe.

items.question: Is my money protected?
items.answer: Customer funds are held in segregated accounts at regulated partner banks and protected up to the local deposit guarantee limit.

items.question: Are there any hidden fees?
items.answer: No. Domestic transfers are free and international transfers show the exact fee and exchange rate before you confirm.

items.question: How fast are payments?
items.answer: Domestic payments arrive instantly. International transfers typically land within one business day.

items.question: What if my card is stolen?
items.answer: Freeze it in the app in one tap. We will ship a replacement within two working days.
